records.title: Method for Revitalizing and Increasing Lithium Ion Battery Capacity
records.abstract: [0001]    A hybrid or electric vehicle includes a lithium-ion battery and a controller. records.abstract: [0001]    The present disclosure relates to methodologies, systems and apparatus for generating lithium ion battery materials. Starting materials are combined to form a homogeneous precursor solution including lithium, and a droplet maker is used to generate droplets of the precursor solution having controlled size. These droplets are introduced into a microwave generated plasma, where micron or sub-micron scale lithium-containing particles are formed. These lithium-containing particles are collected and formed into a slurry to form lithium ion battery materials.

records.title: LITHIUM SECONDARY BATTERY
records.abstract: The present invention relates to a lithium secondary battery which is in a form of a negative electrode-free battery and formed with lithium metal on a positive electrode current collector by charging. The lithium secondary battery forms the lithium metal on the positive electrode current collector in a state of being cut off from the atmosphere. Therefore, generation of a native layer formed on conventional positive electrodes is completely avoided, and deterioration of battery efficiency and lifetime characteristics can be prevented.

The lithium secondary battery forms the lithium metal in a state of being cut off from the atmosphere. records.abstract: A battery having a cathode comprised of a disordered rocksalt and a localized high concentration electrolyte having a halogenated phosphorous additive has improved cycle life.
